newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Key officers of Manila Sun Hung Kai leave.
newsitem.headline: Key officers of Manila Sun Hung Kai leave.

text.p: Three key officials of Sun Hung Kai Securities (Philippines) Inc have left the company after the firm's recent takeover by Allied Property, an industry source said on Monday.
Edwin Villanueva, Sun Hung Kai's president, has left for Vickers Ballas Securities, the source said.
Others who left were Maria Lourdes Sison, Sun Hung Kai's head of sales and Soccoro Fragante, the head of corporate finance, the source said.
Sun Hung Kai Philippines is a unit of Hong Kong's Sun Hung Kai.
The source said the new investors of Sun Hung Kai intended to take an active role in investment banking in the country.
